hero.headline:
I build software
for everyday work.
hero.proof: Offline checkout, inventory, and kitchen orders.
hero.desc: I use Laravel and Kotlin to build operational apps for checkout, inventory, and kitchen workflows.

philosophy.title: I start with the work that needs doing.
philosophy.p1: I develop software and run an F&B business. The needs of cashiers and kitchen staff shape how I think about an app.
philosophy.p2: I care about the details people encounter at work: checkout when the internet drops, stock records, and orders that need to reach the kitchen.
philosophy.p3: I build with Laravel REST APIs on the server and Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on Android.

methodology.title: How I work on a project.

s1.title: 01 Understand the work
s1.desc: I start with who will use the app and which parts of their work are difficult.

s2.title: 02 Map the requirements
s2.desc: I map the data and main workflows, then decide what needs to be built first.

s3.title: 03 Build and test
s3.desc: I build in stages and test the workflows, including what happens when the connection drops.

s4.title: 04 Learn from use
s4.desc: I use bug reports and user feedback to decide what to improve next.

activity.title: My work on GitHub.
activity.desc: You can find my repositories and contributions on GitHub.

projects.title: Some of my work.
projects.desc: Point of sale, internal tools, and websites. Each project answers a different set of needs.
projects.view_arch: View details

p1.title: Kaching! SaaS POS Ecosystem
p1.problem: Need: Cashiers need to record transactions even when the internet connection drops.
p1.solution: What I built: A SaaS POS with offline transactions and WebSocket synchronization for kitchen order screens (KDS).
p1.impact: How it works: Transactions are stored offline, then data syncs when a connection is available.

p2.title: MBG ERP System
p2.label: Local / internal
p2.problem: Need: Catering operations need ingredient stock records and a way to follow procurement through to distribution.
p2.solution: What I built: An internal ERP for catering production workflows with a real-time inventory dashboard.
p2.impact: Scope: Procurement records, ingredient availability, and distribution in one system.

p3.title: Natgrey Business Profile
p3.desc: I built a business profile and digital catalog for Natgrey, an architectural lighting brand. The website presents its products to prospective B2B clients.

p4.title: Car Sales & Inventory
p4.label: Local / internal
p4.desc: I built a vehicle listing app with search and an inventory panel for dealers to manage the vehicles they sell.

p5.title: SmartSAW Decision Logic
p5.desc: I implemented SAW (Simple Additive Weighting) in an app that calculates scores using multiple criteria and their assigned weights.

c1.title: Business context
c1.desc: Running a business makes me consider costs and daily work when deciding which features to build.

c2.title: Code I can maintain
c2.desc: I choose structures I can explain and change as requirements develop.

c3.title: Conditions on the ground
c3.desc: I account for dropped connections and data that needs to stay on the device.

c4.title: Getting it onto the server
c4.desc: I work on the database and API, then handle deployment and server monitoring.

cta.title: Have something I can help with?
cta.desc: I am open to roles and project work. Email me about what you need and the timing you have in mind.
